title: Topic 2
japanese_text: <ruby>私<rt>わたし</rt></ruby>の<ruby>得意<rt>とくい</rt></ruby>な<ruby>料理<rt>りょうり</rt></ruby>はステーキだ。<ruby><u>少々</u><rt>しょうしょう</rt></ruby><ruby>適当<rt>てきとう</rt></ruby>な<ruby>味付<rt>あじつ</rt></ruby>けでも、<ruby>硬<rt>かた</rt></ruby>くならないように<ruby>焼<rt>や</rt></ruby>けば<u>オーケー</u>だ。
english_translation: The dish I'm best at cooking is steak. Even with somewhat careless seasoning, it'll be okay so long as it's cooked so as not to be too tough.
